name: AI-TAgent Request Intake
description: Local, explicitly authorized human request intake. No task execution or Octop delivery.

settings_schema.header: Do not put secrets or sensitive information in slash commands. Server audit logs may contain the full command even when intake is rejected, and have retention separate from the plugin's 7-day receipt access expiry (physical cleanup is lazy). Review every audit sink, export and backup before enabling intake. Disabled by default. Configure a single test team/channel, an existing digital employee Bot, and allowed requester IDs. These settings grant intake access only, not Octop execution permission.

settings.display_name: Verified fresh/quiesced quota storage and synchronized node clocks
settings.help_text: Required for 0.2 admission. Not an automatic migration. Confirm no old-version writers or live legacy receipts remain, primary/replica state is consistent, and node clocks are synchronized. See README; do not reset a live ledger.
